InfraBot: ALERT: Elevated 429+503s across inference-prod routing for the last 3m. 429 rate 12.4% (baseline ~0.6%). Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/ingress-429-503

Alex (oncall): grabbing this. who is up for triage? any obvious noisy tenants?

Maya (sre): looks like a handful of tenants are causing most of the 429s — tenant-123 and tenant-987. spike in embeddings and long-sequence streaming requests. tail latencies spiking -> queueing -> 429s.

Samir (infra): confirmed kernel backlog on frontend-proxy pool, qps surge correlated with a deploy 8m ago? checking deploy bot.

DeployBot: Deploy prod/ingress v2.14 rolled to 60% at 1962349500, no rollout errors.

Maya (sre): rollout doesn't show failures but capacity reduced effective throughput because of changed conn handling in v2.14. temporary mismatch with autoscaler.

Alex (oncall): OK immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply per-tenant emergency QPS caps for top offenders, 2) enable temporary soft global rate limit at edge, 3) disable streaming for non-critical tenants. Samir, can you run caps?

Samir (infra): applying caps now for tenant-123 and tenant-987. using admin API. patching config:
```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/tenant-123/actions
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
{
  "action": "set_rate_limit",
  "payload": {"qps": 3, "burst": 10, "reason": "emergency-429-mitigation"}
}
```
Applying tenant-987 qps=2 as well.

Samir (infra): also toggling global soft limiter to 80% of usual throughput (soft_drop=true)
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/system/ratelimit" -d '{"mode":"soft","pct":80}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Maya (sre): disabling streaming for tenants without 'streaming-critical' tag (will force short-poll responses). command:
```
PATCH https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/featureflags/streaming
{"disabled_for": "non_critical", "reason": "429 mitigation"}
```

Alex (oncall): I'm posting a quick note to #customer-impact and CS. Dmitri can you start customer outreach for the top 5 tenants? need to flag potential degraded throughput and explain caps.

Dmitri (cs): on it. drafting: "We've applied temporary request caps to reduce 429/503 impact. Your traffic should be stable but may see reduced concurrency. We're monitoring and will update in 30m." will paste here when ready.

(2m pass) Maya (sre): dashboard after caps: total 429 rate down to 5.1%, 503s down to 1.2%. tail latency reducing. https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/ingress-429-503?from=now-15m

Alex (oncall): good signal. continue monitoring. next steps: 1) run a quick smoke across sample tenant endpoints to ensure legitimate traffic isn't being overthrottled, 2) consider rolling back v2.14 or scaling frontend pool if rollback impossible. Samir, can you scale frontends by +25%?

Samir (infra): scaling frontend-proxy pool now (k8s autoscaler override).
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/frontend-proxy --replicas=12
```

(6m pass) Maya (sre): smoke tests: sampling 50 requests per tenant-123 -> p95 latency back near baseline, no 5xx. 429s for tenant-123 at 3.4% now.

Alex (oncall): good. I'll hand this to Maya for sustained monitoring and follow-up postmortem. I'll create an incidents ticket and add notes about emergency caps and streaming toggle.

Maya (sre): taking over monitoring. will keep the global soft limiter and tenant caps for 10 more minutes, then progressively relax if metrics stay stable. scheduling a 1h follow-up to decide long-term fix (autoscaler tuning vs rollback).

Dmitri (cs): customer note posted to top-5 tenants, asked for any immediate severity reports.

Alex (oncall): final quick checklist before I drop: - note deploy v2.14 correlation - tenant caps applied (tenant-123 qps=3, tenant-987 qps=2) - global soft limiter ON - streaming disabled for non_critical - frontend scaled +25% - ticket created: INC-2026-378

Maya (sre): copying checklist to the incident ticket. ping me if any regressions.

Alex (oncall): thanks all. passing page to Maya @here :phone:

InfraBot: NOTE: Incident ticket INC-2026-378 created by Alex. Pager cleared for Alex.

Maya (sre): monitoring notes: snapshot at handoff -> 429: 4.8%, 503: 1.1%, error budget burn slowed. Will update every 10m or on regression.

Samir (infra): will keep an eye on autoscaler logs and be ready to rollback v2.14 if we see further instability.

Dmitri (cs): will update customers in 30m with mitigation status.

Alex (oncall): signing off from active. good job everyone :thumbsup:

Maya (sre): thanks — keeping it warm.
